title: A csata lefolyása (The Battle of Mohács)
grammar: Sudden Events: amint, rövid idő alatt

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can recount the course of the Battle of Mohács on August 29, 1526.
I can say who Pál Tomori was and what happened to him at Mohács.
I can describe sudden turns in a battle with amint and rövid idő alatt.
I can use the new vocabulary about battle orders, cavalry and artillery.
